QuestInfo.name: Elluel's Visitor
QuestInfo.0: #p1033100#, the Elder of Magic in #m101050000#, needs to see you. Did something happen in town?
QuestInfo.1: #p1033100# says an old friend has come to town, and wants to see you in #m101050000#. A visitor waiting for the Elven Monarch... Who could it be?
QuestInfo.2: A friend of yours from centuries ago, a Pegasus, came to town to meet you.

0.0: I hope you're doing well, Your Majesty. I've got some great news! An old friend has come back to the village. Please return as soon as you can.
0.1: Please come home and welcome your old friend.

no.0: Are you sure? Of course. You know best, My Liege.

1.0: Mercedes! Oh, Mercedes, I never thought I'd see you again. But you came back to #p1033240#, didn't you?

npc.0: Your old friend awaits, Your Majesty.
